tokens.styling: Lip Gloss chained styles (Bold/Foreground/Padding/Border/Align); adaptive light/dark; cache styles outside the render hot path
tokens.layout: compute widths from lipgloss.Width() + WindowSizeMsg; JoinHorizontal/JoinVertical/Place to compose

components.name: list
components.when_to_use: selectable list with fuzzy filter + pagination + help built in

components.name: viewport
components.when_to_use: scroll long content / rendered markdown (pair with Glamour)

components.name: form
components.when_to_use: prompts/wizard; Group = a page; WithAccessible(true) for screen readers

rules: Always scaffold Model/Init/Update/View; state mutates ONLY in Update (a type-switch on Msg); View is pure.
Route ALL async work through a Cmd (func() Msg); never do I/O in Update/View. Use tea.Batch/Sequence/Tick.
Return m, cmd by value; embedded child components must forward msg to their Update AND bubble up their Cmd, or spinners/timers stop.
Pin ONE major version — v1 (github.com/charmbracelet/* + tea.KeyMsg) OR v2 (charm.land/* + tea.KeyPressMsg) — never mix; version-mixing is the top failure mode.
Within Charm: shell-only prompts -> Gum; wizard -> Huh; full app -> Bubble Tea+Bubbles+Lip Gloss; remote -> Wish (SSH); markdown -> Glamour.
